At the bottom of a pond

theme.prompt: Benjamin was not scared in the garden. Peter kept hearing noises and wanted to go home. Who was right to worry?
choices: Peter, because a cat trapped them under a basket
Nobody, because the garden was empty all day
evidence: Peter did not seem to be enjoying himself; he kept hearing noises
Benjamin, on the contrary, was perfectly at home
Anyway, she sat down upon the top of the basket.
She sat there for five hours.

segments.written: Old Mr. Bunny came looking for Benjamin when he didn't come home. Who comes to help you when you feel stuck or scared?
